text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Together with Curren Bouquetd'or, I raced through three whirlwind years.

text_block_list.name: Race-Loving Celebrity A
text_block_list.text:
—You're famous for your success in the Tenno Sho (Spring) and Japan Cup,
but personally, your performance in the Classic year
left quite an impression on me as well!

text_block_list.name: Race-Loving Celebrity B
text_block_list.text:
I get that! Also, I really loved that documentary
about the Trainers. I ended up binge-watching the whole thing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much.
It feels a bit ticklish somehow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Curren Bouquetd'or's radiance lingered in people's hearts, and she became an Umamusume beloved by many.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And that spotlight—

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>!
Soften your expression a bit more—looking good!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She illuminated even me, her Trainer.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I'm just not quite used to it yet.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
No, no, compared to last time!
aren't you super busy right now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Magazine interviews, media appearances,
commentary, panel discussions—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even more media appearance offers were pouring in than after the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, let's welcome to the stage
Curren Bouquetd'or's Trainer,
Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —My, you certainly look nervous.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: However... hehe. Such loud applause...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Making a name for oneself will, to some degree, benefit one's future career as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I only accept offers within reasonable limits, but... I just can't seem to get used to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dragging my exhausted body back to the Trainer's office
to finish up the remaining work—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Welcome home.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I thought you might be tired,
so I came by to bring you some refreshments.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Do you still have work to do?
Please, take a little rest at least.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I decided to gratefully accept her kindness. The taiyaki she brought was still warm, its sweetness soothing my exhausted body.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Fufu, is that so? I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even though it was the middle of the night, she went out of her way to bring refreshments—a surge of gratitude toward her welled up within me.
choice_data_list: It's thanks to you, every single bit of it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After being told I was always hiding in the shadows, I was handed a golden bouquet and thrust into the spotlight like never before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Above all else—the most important thing
as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Walking alongside her taught me
what an Umamusume and Trainer should truly be."
choice_data_list: Thank you for coming into my life, Bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no, not at all—
The pleasure is all mine.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Just having a golden bouquet gathered for me... fills my heart with so much emotion.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "Yet watching you from the edge of the stage today, I realized something."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
In the future that lies ahead,
you will surely grow even greater.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Just like the golden bouquet I handed you that day,
I'm sure more and more blossoms
will be added to it one by one from here on."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: It could be me, or it could be someone else entirely.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Either way, surely—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...I know it.
Your future will be a wonderful one.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Could anything be happier than this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Why is she always thinking solely of me like this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Why does she show not the slightest hesitation in putting herself second—
choice_data_list: More than anyone, I want you to be happy.
More than anyone, I want you to be happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the center of a future filled with soft light and vibrant colors, she is the one I want to see smiling.
choice_data_list: That's my biggest wish right now.
It's my greatest wish right now.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
“—Is that so?
I couldn't ask for higher praise...”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I will surely move forward toward that future.
If that is your wish for me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"And lastly—
May I make just one selfish request?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, this bouquet will become...
something much, much bigger."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Even if its color, its scent—
its very form becomes something entirely different.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Please, forever.
Let it remain in this shape within your heart.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Even just a corner is fine, so—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Please, keep displaying my bouquet.
